topic: The "rewrite it for my reader" prompt: make any message shorter and clearer for the person reading it
post:
Wrote a long message and worried nobody will read it? ✍️
This copy-paste prompt rewrites it for the person who has to read it.

Most people ask AI to "make this better".
Better for who? 🤔

Anthropic's prompting guide says Claude works best with clear, direct instructions and context about why. So tell it who's reading and what they need.

Copy this prompt 👇
"Rewrite the message below for [who's reading, e.g. my busy manager].
Keep it under [100] words.
Put the main point or request in the first line.
Keep every date, number and name exactly as written.
Then list anything you removed, so I can check it.

[paste your message]"

Example:
A 300-word project update becomes 4 lines: the decision you need, the deadline, and one risk. ✅

The last line is the safety net 🔑
"List anything you removed" means nothing important disappears without you knowing.

Why it matters:
The best message isn't the one that says the most. It's the one that gets read. 💡

Who would you rewrite a message for first? 👇

Follow me: I'm teaching one Claude skill a day, no tech background needed.

#Claude #AI #AIForBeginners #Productivity
